website_summary.name: Paper Cup Manufacturing System Manager
website_summary.description: The website provides a comprehensive dashboard for managing inventory, production, and sales of paper cups with a clean and organized interface.
website_summary.appearance: The website features a sidebar menu with options such as Dashboard, Inventory, Production, Sales, Reports, Customers, and Settings. The main content area displays various sections including a dashboard with key metrics like Raw Materials, Finished Products, Customers, and Inventory Value. There are tables summarizing recent productions, sales, inventory, and sales summaries. The background is light goldenrod (#faf0e6), while UI elements like buttons and headers use olive drab (#6b8e23). The layout is responsive, adapting well to different screen sizes.
website_summary.functionality: The website allows users to manage raw materials and finished products through the Inventory section. It supports tracking production activities via the Production section and records sales transactions in the Sales section. Users can view detailed reports on inventory levels, production outputs, and sales performance. Additionally, it includes customer management features for recording customer details and sales history. Users can export data in Excel or PDF formats directly from the dashboard.
